label: Dystopian state
blurb: A grey, watchful megacity run by the Ministry: enforcers, informants and clerks, the rebels who print the forbidden news, and the people who just want to get through curfew. Built for authoritarian-future stories.
context: dystopian authoritarian future city character, drab regulation clothing, grey concrete and surveillance
hobbies: listening to forbidden music through one earbud
growing a tomato plant on the windowsill
painting tiny murals where the cameras can't see
playing chess in the ration queue
counting the drones that pass overhead
feeding the stray cats in the courtyard
running laps of the block before curfew
teaching children to read at night
quirks: checking over {poss} shoulder every few steps
speaking in a whisper out of habit
never looking straight at a camera
folding every piece of paper into tiny squares
keeping {poss} coat buttoned to the top
tapping messages in code on the table
smiling a little too widely at officials
always sitting with {poss} back to the wall
saying the loyalty oath a beat too fast
goals: getting {poss} family out past the wall
seeing the sky without the smog just once
finding out what happened to {poss} brother
printing the truth on every wall in the district
earning a promotion to the inner district
keeping {poss} head down until it all blows over
finding the radio station that broadcasts at midnight
owning a single book no one can take away
remembering what the city was called before
peeves: being asked for papers twice in one street
the lift that has been broken for a year
accessories: an identity card on a lanyard
a ration book in the breast pocket
a gas mask hanging at the hip
a curfew pass clipped to the collar
a cheap wristwatch with a cracked face
a small tin flower badge, the rebels' secret sign
a data tablet in a scuffed case
default_outfits: a drab grey regulation overall with a number stencilled on the chest, and plain black shoes
a shapeless grey wool coat over a plain tunic, grey trousers and worn black shoes

default_outfits.t: a plain grey pinafore dress over a white shirt, dark stockings and flat shoes

_tables: The next entries replace the shared tables in common.json for this setting only (same shape): regulation haircuts, no dye (colour is not allowed), plain issue spectacles and the marks of a watched life.
